user.title: LocalVolts v2
user.description: Enter the LocalVolts v2 API credentials and the authorized NMI to monitor.

data_description.api_key: Enter the API key. The required apikey prefix is added automatically if omitted.
data_description.partner_id: The LocalVolts partner ID paired with this API key.
data_description.nmi: The NMI authorized for this API key and partner ID.
data_description.v1_api_key: Optional and separate from v2. Used only for v1 comparison data.
data_description.v1_partner_id: Optional v1 partner ID paired with the v1 API key.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to LocalVolts. Check network access and try again.
error.invalid_auth: LocalVolts rejected the API key, partner ID, or NMI authorization.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log.

init.title: LocalVolts v2 Options
init.description: Set how often LocalVolts data is updated. Intervals are five minutes, and values below 60 seconds are not accepted.
